name: info
content: Connect to a Typesense instance using a **search-only API key** (`documents:search` action). See the plugin documentation for how to create one.

name: host
label: Host URL
help: Your Typesense base URL including `https://` and **no trailing slash**. For Typesense Cloud this is `https://<nodes-hostname>`.

pattern.message: Enter the base URL including https:// and no trailing slash or path

name: apiKey
label: Search API Key
help: A search-only API key. This is stored securely and sent in the `X-TYPESENSE-API-KEY` header.

name: collection
label: Collection
help: The collection this connection queries. The API key must be authorised for it. Add another connection to query another collection.
